question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given group of words.

On cloud nine
solution:
The correct answer is '**Being very delighted**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**On cloud nine**" means being very delighted or extremely happy. (बहुत खुश)
 
• It is often used to describe a state of perfect happiness or joy.
 
• The other options: "**Being angry with someone**," "**Flying in the sky**," and "**Being very high**" do not convey the correct meaning of the phrase.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Example Sentence:** *She was on cloud nine__ after receiving the good news.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Being angry with someone (किसी पर गुस्सा होना)**: means having a feeling of resentment or displeasure.
 
• **Flying in the sky (आसमान में उड़ना)**: means being airborne or traveling through the air.
 
• **Being very high (बहुत ऊँचा होना)**: means being at a great height or level.
